texts.li: Somebody has to decide about the raiders' bodies, and {A_nameDef} thinks it should be the council. They're still lying where they fell.
[night] {A_nameDef} couldn't sleep for thinking about the dead raiders outside. {A_nameDef} wants the council to say what's done with them before another night goes by.
[past:soldier] {A_nameDef} has buried enemies before, and left them before, and says neither sits easy. The raiders' bodies are still out there, and {A_nameDef} wants the council's word on them.
[colony:Merciful] The colony has a name for mercy, and {A_nameDef} says it shouldn't stop at the living. The raiders still lie where they fell.
[snow] Snow is settling on the raiders where they fell. {A_nameDef} wants the council to decide what's done with them before they're buried in it.
[grieving] {A_nameDef} lost someone in the fight, and still went out to look at the raiders' bodies. {A_nameDef} wants them dealt with, one way or another, and soon.

lines.li: The raiders went into graves outside the wall before dark. {A_nameDef} said a few words over them, and not everyone stayed to listen.
[rain] They dug the graves in the mud, and the raiders went into them wet.
[winter] The pyre burned hot against the cold, and people stood closer to it than they meant to.
[night] The pyre lit the wall all night, and the ones on watch kept their backs to it.
[trait:Kind] The bodies went to the treeline. {A_nameDef} wasn't happy about it, and said so at supper.
[summer|hot] The bodies went out to the treeline in the heat, and the wind brought the smell back for days.
[rain] One trench for all of them, dug in the rain and filled in before dark.
The raiders went into the crematorium one by one. It took until dark.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} has gone from one person to the next since the fighting stopped, checking on each of them. Now {A_nameDef} wants a feast tonight, about {COUNT} raw food, and the repairs left until morning.
[skill:Cooking] {A_nameDef} already has the big pot out and is eyeing the stores. A victory feast would take about {COUNT} raw food, and {A_nameDef} wants the council's word before lighting the fire.

[past:soldier] {A_nameDef} has seen fighters go straight from a battle back to work, and says they break a week later. {A_nameDef} wants a feast tonight, about {COUNT} raw food, and the walls left until morning.
[hurt] {A_nameDef} is still patched up from the fight, and still wants the colony to eat well tonight: about {COUNT} raw food, with the damage seen to tomorrow.
[colony:Generous] The colony shares what it has, and {A_nameDef} says tonight is the night for it: a victory feast of about {COUNT} raw food, with the repairs left until morning.
[rain] The raiders are gone and the rain hasn't stopped. {A_nameDef} wants everyone inside, dry and fed, with a feast of about {COUNT} raw food tonight.
[colony:Thrifty] {A_nameDef} knows how carefully the colony counts its stores, and asks anyway: a victory feast tonight, about {COUNT} raw food, while people are still glad to be alive.

lines.li: They ate together until late, and the talk kept going back to the fight.
[rain] They ate indoors with the rain on the roof, and the noise of it was lost under the talking.
[colony:Generous] The stores were opened wide, and they ate until well after dark.
Repairs first. The colony went straight back out to the walls, and the feast wasn't mentioned again.
[winter] Repairs first, in the cold, with numb fingers. The celebration never happened.
[rain] A hot meal went round under the eaves, eaten standing, and then it was back out to the walls.
{B_nameDef} thinned the stew and cut the portions small, and it still went round twice. They ate until late.

riskLines.li: {B_nameDef}'s pots ran dry before the last of them had eaten. The ones who missed out got the scrapings and a promise.

texts.li: {A_nameDef} has told the story of the last fight at every meal since, and in every version {A_nameDef} is the one who turned it. {B_nameDef} was there too and remembers it differently.\n\nThey want the council to settle it.

[skill:Shooting] {A_nameDef} says the fight turned on one good shot, and it was {A_possessive}. {B_nameDef} says it was {B_possessive}, and that {A_nameDef} missed.\n\nNeither will let it go until the council decides.

[skill:Melee] {A_nameDef} was in the thick of the last fight and says so. {B_nameDef} was too, and says {A_nameDef} spent most of it behind {B_objective}.\n\nThe council is asked to say who saved the colony.

[trait:Greedy] {A_nameDef} has worked out that whoever saved the colony ought to be thanked properly, and that it was {A_nameDef}. {B_nameDef} has come to the same view about {B_objective}self.\n\nBoth want the council to decide.

[evening] Supper has turned into an argument again. {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} each say they're the one who held the raiders off, and the rest of the table has picked sides.\n\nThey want the council to settle it.
[colony:Harsh] In this colony the fighters are what keep it standing, and the credit for a fight matters. {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} both claim the last one and want the council to say whose it was.

lines.li: The council named {A_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} has told the story twice since, and {B_nameDef} has left the room both times.

riskLines.li: {B_nameDef} wouldn't accept it. Words turned to shoving, and the shoving turned into a fight.

lines.li: The council named {B_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} said nothing at all, which worried people more than shouting would have.

riskLines.li: {A_nameDef} took the council's answer badly and went looking for {B_nameDef} to say so with {A_possessive} fists.

lines.li: The witnesses talked it over and decided it had been a near thing for all of them. {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} have let the matter drop, not happily.
The credit went to everyone who fought. {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} both said that was fair, and neither of them meant it.
